title: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Types of Port Emission Sources) As used in Article 2, Paragraph 6 of the "Special Act on Improving Air Quality in Port Areas, etc." (hereinafter referred to as "the Act"), "things specified by a Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries ordinance" refers to any of the following:
1. Vessels
2. Loading and unloading equipment
3. Automobiles
4. Construction machinery as defined in Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the "Construction Machinery Management Act" (excluding vessels and automobiles)
5. Any other facilities, machinery, equipment, and objects that emit air pollutants in port areas, as designated by the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries as requiring management.
